Smooths lines with cubic Bezier curves through their vertices, with the line smoother of the jaitools project.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Smoothing, Vector, Bezier<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.LineSmootherJaitools`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inVector` | vector file |  |  | The vector containing the lines to be smoothed. |
| `pAlpha` | double |  | `0` | A value between 0 and 1 (inclusive) specifying the tightness of fit of the smoothed line: 0 is the loosest, 1 keeps the straight segments. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outVector` | output file |  | The smoothed features. |

**References**

- Shemanarev, M. Interpolation with Bezier Curves: a very simple method of smoothing polygons. http://www.antigrain.com/research/bezier_interpolation/index.html
